body:
## What

- Adds the first deterministic meta-expression prototype as a library API, CLI, HTTP microservice, and static web playground.
- Implements a links-network data shape with statement links, interpretation links, formalization links, dependency relation links, evidence links, support/refute relation links, provenance, and confidence results.
- Supports the initial vertical slice:
  - `1 + 1 = 2` -> computed true with confidence `1`
  - `1 + 1 = 1` -> computed false with confidence `0`
  - `Earth orbits the Sun` -> Wikidata-backed fixture evidence with provenance
- Updates the issue #1 case study to use links-network terminology instead of graph/node/edge terminology.
- Adds a detailed `ROADMAP.md` for Rust/WASM/React, real Links Notation parsing, Relative Meta Logic, live Wikidata, Doublets persistence, and the remaining long-term requirements.
- Adds meta-theory source captures and PR feedback captures under `docs/case-studies/issue-1/data/`.

## Why

Fixes #1 by moving beyond a documentation-only case study into a minimal working playground while keeping the larger architecture and deferred work explicit.

## Screenshots

![Mobile prototype](https://github.com/link-assistant/meta-expression/blob/issue-1-66f2990709b5/docs/case-studies/issue-1/prototype-web-mobile.png?raw=true)

## Testing

- `npm test`
- `npm run check`
- `scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh`
- `git diff --check HEAD`
- `bun test`
- `deno test --allow-read`
- CLI smoke: `node src/cli.js analyze "1 + 1 = 2" --format links`
- Microservice smoke: `GET /health` and `GET /analyze?input=...`
- Playwright render checks for desktop and mobile static web app, including console check and screenshot capture
- `node scripts/validate-changeset.mjs`
